title: Create src/lib/progress/logReader.ts — parse recent activity from LOG.md
description: Create a module that reads LOG.md and parses the last N session entries into a typed array. Returns empty array if LOG.md doesn't exist.
acceptanceCriteria: Returns correct entries for a fixture LOG.md
Returns [] when LOG.md does not exist
Each entry has taskId, taskTitle, timestamp, backend, outcome

steps.details: Create the file. Define: export type ActivityEntry = { taskId: number; taskTitle: string; backend: string; outcome: string; timestamp: Date }

export async function readRecentActivity(agentDir: string, n = 5): Promise<ActivityEntry[]> { const logPath = path.join(agentDir, 'logs', 'LOG.md'); if (!await fs.pathExists(logPath)) return []; const content = await fs.readFile(logPath, 'utf-8'); return parseLogSections(content).slice(-n) }
Parse LOG.md by splitting on '## Session' headers. For each section, extract the task ID, title, backend, and outcome using regex matching on the markdown list format defined in log.ts.

technicalNotes: The parser must match the format defined by appendSessionLog in log.ts — they must stay in sync
Use regex like /- \*\*Task\*\*: #(\d+) (.+)/ to extract task ID and title
